# Amsterdam Pop-ups

> A weekly guide to Amsterdam that leads with pop-ups (pop-up restaurants, shops and supper clubs), plus temporary and one-off events, markets, small gigs, film and shows, with last-minute ideas and days out: food, art, family and culture. Every event is checked on the organiser's own page before it is listed. English and Dutch.

The guide is edited by hand and updated every week (Monday to Sunday). Each listing has a date, time, venue address, price and a link to the organiser's page. Past weeks stay in the Archive on the main site.

## This week (16 – 22 Nov, 102 events)

- [This week's events as a plain list](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/this-week.html): every event with date, time, venue, price, organiser, description and link; readable without JavaScript
- [Interactive guide](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/): map, category and day filters, English/Dutch toggle, archive
- Dutch versions: [interactive guide](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/nl/), [plain list](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/nl/deze-week.html), and each category page below under /nl/
- [Christmas pop-ups and events in Amsterdam](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/christmas/): season-long list of short-run Christmas markets, winter terraces, workshops and light-festival walks (Dutch: [Kerst pop-ups en evenementen in Amsterdam](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/nl/kerst/))
- [New Year's Eve pop-ups and events in Amsterdam](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/new-years-eve/): season-long list of short-run New Year's Eve and New Year's Day pop-ups and one-off events (Dutch: [Pop-ups en evenementen voor oud en nieuw in Amsterdam](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/nl/oud-en-nieuw/))

- Business (NL: Zakelijk)
- Networking (NL: Netwerken)

Events can belong to several categories. "Regular" marks weekly or recurring series; everything else is a one-off or limited run.
